title: Secretary of State of Illinois

context.text: Giannoulias is also considered a frontrunner for Chicago mayor in 2027; if he won both offices, Gov. JB Pritzker would appoint a secretary of state to a full term, the Sun-Times and WBEZ report.
Diane Harris defeated Walter Adamczyk 53.0% to 47.0% in the March 17 Republican primary; Giannoulias was unopposed.
The State Board of Elections' candidate list shows Giannoulias (Democratic) and Harris (Republican) as active candidates; Green Party filer Jeffrey Schiefelbein is listed as removed on July 14, 2026.

candidates.name: Alexi Giannoulias
candidates.ballotNote: Advanced unopposed from the March 17 Democratic primary.

summary.text: Alexi Giannoulias is the Democratic Secretary of State of Illinois, seeking re-election. A former state treasurer (2007-2011), he is running on 'momentum on modernization' of the office's services and has announced a run for Chicago mayor in 2027.

background.text: Earned a bachelor's degree in economics from Boston University (1998) and a law degree from Tulane University (2002).
Founded and was CEO of Annoula Ventures and chaired the Illinois Community College Board.
Illinois State Treasurer from 2007 to 2011; Secretary of State since 2023.

priorities.text: Keep up 'momentum on modernization' of the office, including online DMV appointments and DMV kiosks.
Create consequences and accountability for violations of state law governing license plate reader data, and pathways for accountability after federal immigration authorities searched state data.

record.text: Introduced online appointment scheduling and kiosks for Secretary of State facility services, as described by the Sun-Times.
Rolled back testing requirements for elderly drivers, as described by the Sun-Times.

candidates.researchNotes: Record items come from news reporting; official rules, press releases and certifications were not itemized. His campaign site was not located.

candidates.name: Diane Harris
candidates.ballotNote: Won the March 17 Republican primary over Walter Adamczyk, 53.0% to 47.0%.

summary.text: Diane Harris is the Republican nominee for Secretary of State. She describes herself as an entrepreneur and was the Republican nominee for the 43rd State Senate district in 2022.

background.text: Earned an associate degree from Joliet Junior College and a bachelor's degree from the University of Phoenix.
Republican nominee for state Senate in 2022 (lost).

priorities.text: Ensure the office follows state law on license plate readers.
Require driving tests for all age groups, differing from Giannoulias's rollback of testing for elderly drivers.
Criticized Giannoulias for seeking the mayoralty and the office at the same time: 'The people deserve someone who's committed to serving this state's office.'

candidates.researchNotes: No campaign website or Ballotpedia survey found; positions come from a Sun-Times candidate questionnaire as summarized by the Sun-Times. Green Party filer Jeffrey Schiefelbein was removed from the ballot on July 14, 2026 per the State Board of Elections and is not included.
